newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill initiates SmarTone coverage.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill initiates SmarTone coverage.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has initiated coverage of SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Ltd with an "accumulate" recommendation despite significantly greater levels of future competition.

"SmarTone represents the first opportunity for direct investor participation in the booming Hong Kong cellular market," Merrill Lynch analysts Adam Quinton and Craig Irvine said in a report dated December 13.
Through its GSM network, SmarTone is an established player in the rapidly growing Hong Kong cellular market, the report said.
But it said Merrill believed there would be significantly greater competition over the 1997-99 period as up to six new PCS networks come on stream.

The analysts said they expected SmarTone to achieve 20 percent cumulative average growth in earnings before tax in the years 1996 to 2001, based on 22 percent growth in subscribers for the same period.
The report said SmarTone was valued at HK$18.30 per share on a discounted cash flow basis.
SmarTone shares closed up HK$0.60 at HK$14.90 on Friday.
